principles.statement: Declare the AI role before interpreting any output: generator, tutor, feedback provider, evaluator, conversation partner or TTS source.
Maintain separate validity scopes for AI generation, tutoring, feedback, evaluation, conversation and synthetic speech; success in one role does not authorize another.
Keep AI-generated tasks, examples and explanations downstream of curriculum prerequisites, target constraints and support-leakage checks.
Prefer deterministic validators, curated keys and explicit constraint checks whenever the construct permits them instead of asking an LLM to validate its own output.
Treat LLM corrective feedback as a candidate diagnosis unless that feedback type is validated for the learner population, task, construct and response mode.
Do not infer complete error coverage from high precision among flagged issues; preserve opportunities for learner self-repair and independent later evidence.
Do not allow a holistic LLM score or unvalidated AI judgment to set mastery, retention or capability state directly.
For subjective, pragmatic or diagnostic criteria with weak validation, downgrade AI output to a hint, question, candidate label or supporting observation rather than a definitive correction.
Store provider, model, model version or snapshot, prompt version, rubric version, decoding or scoring configuration and timestamp for every AI output that affects learning decisions or evidence.
Run a fixed regression suite for Nếp-relevant tasks after any provider, model, prompt, rubric or scoring-pipeline change before restoring evidence-producing authority.
Mark TTS provenance explicitly and quality-check voice, rate, pronunciation and target-form realization rather than treating all synthetic audio as interchangeable.
Use TTS for scalable controlled input or support where validated, but require unseen human or natural speech in transfer evidence before claiming robust listening capability.
Treat AI conversation as supported practice and verify later interaction with less accommodating or human-like conditions before promoting human-interaction capability.
Minimize learner data sent to third-party AI services, separate raw dialogue or audio from durable evidence where feasible, and keep privacy/accountability controls explicit.

When AI outputs disagree, fall outside validated scope or have insufficient confidence, fail to no-judgment, neutral retry, deterministic fallback or review rather than issuing a confident false correction.

Keep provider mix, model scopes, feedback thresholds, TTS policy, escalation policy, privacy controls and regression cadence falsifiable until EXP-020 validates them with Vietnamese near-A0/A1 learners.
